limitations: Partial facet: existing non-generated Go files become the exact canonical gofmt output without other source edits. Count signed repairs and exact reversals; JavaScript formatting, other lint rules, behavior and full tests remain separate.
Corroborated markers and explicit GitHub graph links are not safe-output creation receipts or exclusive causal attribution.
This cohort excludes unresolved workflow markers, comments, edited-away markers and deleted outputs.
Links discovered after the PR merged are not used to backdate contribution.
Merge and check rollups do not prove native improvement, race safety, behavior preservation or required-regression acceptance.
Zero in this narrow corroborated facet does not establish zero overall workflow value.
Native repository changes count regardless of actor; the plot shows only independently graph-linked shared contributions.
A zero interval is supported by a complete immutable source scan, not invented from absent evidence.
Go formatting is pinned to the retained Go toolchain; newer tooling can differ. No full-goal, safety, cost or keep-bar claim is inferred.
